_about: Price table and spending policy for tools/pipeline/tripo.py. Prices are credits (1 credit = USD 0.01) from the official pricing table read on 2026-10-26 (docs/milestones/M4-codemap/toolchain-tripo-gemini.md section 2.5). tripo.py reads every number it charges from here, never from a literal; a call that has no price here is refused. The policy block is the plan's A10: before every task the script refuses if (live balance - frozen - expected) < balance_floor, or if max(ledger sum, start_balance - live balance) + expected > ledger_stop. There is deliberately no flag to override either; past ledger_stop the lead asks Game-boy and edits this file.

generation._about: image-to-model and multiview-to-model share one table. no_texture is texture=false; standard/detailed/extreme is texture_quality with texture on (pbr=true forces texture on). 'fast' is priced as 'standard' (quality_alias).

texture._about: POST /models/texture, by texture_quality; 'detailed' is the HD tier and 'extreme' the 8K tier.

unverified.note: The docs do not price texture v3.5 on generation; it is assumed equal to the standard tier. The first real task's credits_consumed settles it (plan section 10, T1: above 30 means fall back to v3.0-20250812).
The docs do not price texture v3.5 on /models/texture; it is assumed equal to its quality tier (fast and standard 10).
POST /files is not in the price table; assumed free. The ledger's balance before and after the first task would show otherwise.
